prerequisites: Knowledge of automatic control (continuous, sampled and event-driven systems) and signal processing is desirable.

learning_outcomes.text: Implement and operate a technical system supervision system, enabling them to detect faults, establish diagnoses, manage operating modes to best meet objectives and plan maintenance interventions.
Specify requirements in terms of system supervision, carry out tests, and interact with other stakeholders in charge of their deployment or upgrading.

teaching_methods: Lectures with illustrations and some direct applications

J.M. Chatain. Diagnostic par système expert. Ed. Hermès, 1993.
J. Richalet. Pratique de l'identification. Ed. Hermès, 1991.
E. Davalo, P. Naïm. Des Réseaux de Neurones. Ed. Eyrolles, 1992.
J. Hérault, C. Jutten. Réseaux neuronaux et traitement de signal. Ed. Hermès, 1994.
G. Vachtsevanos, F.L. Lewis, M. Roemer, A. Hess, B. Wu. Intelligent fault diagnosis and prognosis for engineering systems. Ed. John Wiley & Sons, 2006.
